author: Living With Arthritis Editorial Team
content:
Quick answer: Simple balanced meals can support general health. No individual recipe has been proven to cure arthritis.

Vegetable and lentil soup

Cook carrots, onion, lentils and tinned tomatoes with low-salt stock until tender.

Fish or tofu with vegetables

Cook seasonal vegetables and fish or tofu thoroughly, and serve with rice or potatoes.

Oats and fruit

Mix porridge oats with milk or a suitable alternative and add fruit.

Nutrition and arthritis

A varied diet supports general health but does not replace medical treatment. Discuss restrictive diets with a clinician or registered dietitian.

Sources

Educational information; clinical review pending.
